events.title: Earthquake (地震)

alarm.title: J-Alert Early Warning
alarm.jp_phrase: 「緊急地震速報です。強い揺れに備えてください。」
alarm.meaning: Emergency Earthquake Early Warning: Strong shaking expected imminent.

events.immediate_action: Drop, Cover, and Hold On. Protect your head immediately.
steps: Take shelter under a sturdy table or cover your head with a bag/pillow.
Stay away from glass windows, unanchored bookcases, and tall furniture.
Do not rush outside while shaking is active; falling tiles and glass are dangerous.
When shaking stops, extinguish open flames and open doors to secure an exit route.

events.title: Tsunami Warning (津波警報)

alarm.title: Tsunami Coastal Siren
alarm.jp_phrase: 「ウー...（長鳴3秒・休止2秒）...津波警報」
alarm.meaning: Tsunami Warning: Continuous long siren tones indicate immediate evacuation to high ground.

events.immediate_action: Evacuate immediately to high ground or a Tsunami Evacuation Building.
steps: If you feel strong or long shaking near the coast, evacuate before official orders.
Move on foot to higher ground (3rd floor or higher of a reinforced concrete building).
Avoid using cars, as traffic gridlock can prevent evacuation.
Stay on high ground; tsunamis arrive in multiple waves over several hours.

events.title: Town Broadcast (防災行政無線)

alarm.title: Disaster Wireless Speaker
alarm.jp_phrase: 「緊急放送。避難指示が発令されました。」
alarm.meaning: Emergency Broadcast: Evacuation Instruction (Level 4) has been issued.

events.immediate_action: Listen carefully to community speakers and follow local instructions.
steps: Look for local officials or shelter guidance if audio is muffled by wind or rain.
Prepare emergency grab-bag and head to the nearest evacuation shelter.

events.title: Extreme Heat & Stroke (熱中症)
events.immediate_action: Move to an air-conditioned room and hydrate with water and electrolytes.
steps: Use air conditioning continuously during Heat Stroke Alerts (熱中症警戒アラート).
Drink fluids frequently even before feeling thirsty.
If someone is dizzy or confused, loosen their clothing and apply ice to their neck and armpits.
